first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person riding Vehicle A, with red-orange covering garments on the head and shoulders, light-colored garment panels on the upper body, blue-green trousers on the lower body, and a light-gray face covering visible in close view.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The motorcycle-like vehicle ridden by Person A, with beige and gray-olive angular bodywork, a central seating area, and handlebars.

entities.name: dust-and-smoke trail
entities.identification: A dark-gray clustered band and light-beige dust clouds extending behind Vehicle A, with gray-brown patches within the light-colored clouds.

entities.name: orange sandy ground
entities.identification: The warm orange-yellow ground at the bottom of the canyon, with fine dots, short lines, faint marks, and scattered rocks on its surface.

entities.name: reddish-brown canyon wall
entities.identification: The distant pink to reddish-brown wall surface behind the rock towers, with a dark yellow-brown sloping band along the lower-right edge in the early part.

entities.name: group of red-orange layered rock towers
entities.identification: A group of towering red-orange rock columns, with dense, light-colored, wavy horizontal strata on the tower bodies and irregular overhanging contours.

entities.name: pink plate-like component
entities.identification: A bright-pink, thick, plate-like component in the lower part of a rock tower, with a relatively thick border, angled corners, and dark lines.

entities.name: scattered rocks
entities.identification: Reddish-brown blocky rocks and smaller flat stones on the sandy ground, some with dark sides.

entities.name: distant reddish-brown small object
entities.identification: A low reddish-brown target at the base of the distant wall, with branching and clustered contours.

entities.name: pale cyan sky
entities.identification: The uniformly bright, pale cyan background behind both the rock towers and the distant canyon wall.

entities.name: white clouds
entities.identification: Large white patches in the pale cyan sky, with smoothly curved outer edges.

entities.name: light-gray pod-like component attached to the rock tower
entities.identification: Light-gray shell-like components on the rock towers, including a tall trapezoidal component and a distant low elongated component.

entities.name: pink platform of the rock tower
entities.identification: Pink platforms extending outward from the sides or top edges of the rock towers, some with light-colored barriers and thin rods.

entities.name: exposed tubular component of the rock tower
entities.identification: Dark upright short tubular parts atop the towers, and a reddish-brown tubular part that bends downward beside a light-gray component.

entities.name: hanging green vegetation on the rock tower
entities.identification: Dark-green vegetation hanging down along the sides of the rock towers and the edges of platforms, including both broader leaf clusters and slender strip-like parts.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The small dark flying bird in the upper part of the sky in frames 113 through 119 at the end of the clip, with wing-like projections on both sides; Animal A is bound to this continuously visible trajectory in this clip.

In frame 119, the group of red-orange layered rock towers consists of towering red-orange columns of varying thicknesses, with irregular tops and overhanging contours; fine, wavy horizontal strata in light beige, pinkish white, and gray-brown undulate along the tower bodies, whose surfaces have dark dotted textures and hard-edged shadows.
